sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Use *itt* for here and *ott* for there. Treat *lakom* and *laksz* as useful whole forms at this stage.

itt and ott are a matched pair — itt points at you, ott points away, much like English ‘here’ and ‘there.’ For now, just swallow lakom and laksz whole as fixed chunks meaning ‘I live’ and ‘you live’; the reasoning behind why they end differently — it’s about who’s doing the living — will click once you meet the full verb conjugation pattern later in the course.
